[[File:Solar Token.png|thumb|The '''Solar Token''']]

The '''Solar Token''' is a consumable item obtained from the [[Traveling Merchant]].  
It can be used to trigger the '''Solar Flare''' [[Events|event]].

== Obtainment ==
* Available from the [[Traveling Merchant]].  
* Costs {{$|500,000,000}} or {{Meteor Shards|300}}.  
* Stock: '''2'''.

== Usage ==
* Using the token prompts a confirmation: ''Would you like to use Solar Token? Use again to activate.''  
* Prevents accidental consumption.  
* Triggers the Solar Flare event.

== Trivia ==
* Older servers showed a shared stock of 3.  
* Confirmation was added after the Traveling Merchant update to prevent misclicks.  
* Modern servers handle the stock client-side, so every player can purchase their own.
